Module.Title: The New Unknown for Daggerheart
Module.Description: The New Unknown science-fiction playtest compendium module for the Foundryborne Daggerheart system.

Pack.tnu-gear: The New Unknown: Gear and Implants
Pack.tnu-journals: The New Unknown: Lore and Rules

Source.TheNewUnknownV2: The New Unknown Playtest Volume 2.0 - Mind

0Cn4OpnHhweSNRQl.Description:
Deep Reserves: Gain +1 Stress.
Hardwired: You can have one cybernetic implant without gaining permanent Trauma. You start with Body Arsenal: a retractable one-handed primary weapon grafted to your body; ignore its burden.
0Cn4OpnHhweSNRQl.Name: Transhuman - Armament

0HNZgFn6XNUsAkcV.Description:
A Protean subclass for unseen movement and decisive strikes.
Foundation - Ghost Strike: When you succeed on an attack with advantage or while Shrouded, spend a Hope to add Tier d6s to the damage roll.
Specialization - Tactical Cloak: Mark a Stress to become Shrouded at any time until you roll with Fear or the scene ends.
Mastery - Vanishing Point: Once per rest, when an attack would hit you, mark 2 Stress to become Shrouded, teleport within Far range, and cause the attack to miss.
0HNZgFn6XNUsAkcV.Name: Spectre

9x7MlXxtmHl3QOCp.Description: Logical Explanation: If you spend an uninterrupted hour inspecting technical advice or an artifact, ask the GM three questions about its purpose and function.
9x7MlXxtmHl3QOCp.Name: Logicrooted

bpdZaJDjBLzn6lkb.Description:
Clear Thought: When you make a Knowledge Roll, spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.
Neural Plasticity: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, mark a Stress to reroll.
bpdZaJDjBLzn6lkb.Name: Homo Novus - Lucid

dW19p02GwhTCJZFd.Description:
A rule-breaker who survives by luck, deception, tech, and perfect timing.
Loaded Dice: At the start of each session, roll d12s equal to your subclass Power trait. Spend a Loaded Die on an action roll to swap one Duality Die value with the Loaded Die value. Clear unspent Loaded Dice at session end.
Cheap Tricks: When an adversary moves into Very Close range, mark a Stress to force a Reaction Roll against 10 + your level. On a failure, the target is temporarily Weakened or Vulnerable.
Hope Feature - Cheat Fate: Spend 3 Hope after an action roll to reroll one or both Duality Dice.
Class Items: A pair of loaded dice or a signal scrambler.
dW19p02GwhTCJZFd.Name: Cheat

iaVal5H6qCL1uEzB.Description:
Bio-Armor: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.
Hard to Kill: When you Avoid Death on a death move, reroll your Hope Die once.
iaVal5H6qCL1uEzB.Name: Visc

IfG9Ug8yXFuI3iK3.Description:
Self-Sustaining: You do not need to breathe and can survive in the cold vacuum of space.
Android: Choose one top or bottom ancestry feature of your choice.
IfG9Ug8yXFuI3iK3.Name: Android

k8KairawoEhFeAvI.Description:
Fast Response: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on a reaction roll.
Neural Plasticity: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, mark a Stress to reroll.
k8KairawoEhFeAvI.Name: Homo Novus - Vigil

llosN4M2dCFjABRF.Description:
A master of advanced systems, experimental tools, and battlefield engineering.
Scanning Array: Detect technological signatures and exotic energy patterns within Close range. You know whether an object is powered, dormant, or offline.
System Patch: Once per session, gain a Charge and place it on a Tech card within Close range, or suppress a malfunction or glitch effect until the end of the scene.
Overload the System: Once per long rest, vault a Tech card from your loadout. Either gain Charges equal to its level and distribute them among charge-storing cards, or return an equal-or-lower-level Tech card from your vault to your loadout.
Hope Feature - Energy Surge: Spend 3 Hope to gain 2 Charge tokens on a card that can store Charges.
Class Items: A set of modular tools or a portable power cell.
llosN4M2dCFjABRF.Name: Architect

QH1OuNUJCqOeoj5A.Description:
An Architect subclass that turns the body into a modular weapons platform.
Foundation - Modular Arsenal: Take two Tier 1 modules, then two additional modules at your tier or lower whenever you reach a new tier. Your Energy Core stores 1 Charge, gains a Charge after a long rest, and spends Charges to activate modules until the scene ends or another module is activated.
Specialization - Enhanced Core: Your Energy Core stores up to 2 Charges. After a rest, choose one Tech card in your loadout; it can use Energy Core Charges.
Mastery - Masterwork Core: Your Energy Core stores up to 3 Charges. After a rest, choose two Tech cards in your loadout; they can use Energy Core Charges. You can activate a second module without ending the first.
Tier 1 modules: Targeting Node, Hydraulic Frame, Integrated Weapon, Shock Fist, Atmos-Sealed.
Tier 2 modules: Mag-Grip Boots, Spectral Optics, Ballistic Amplifier, Overstride, Chameleon Mesh.
QH1OuNUJCqOeoj5A.Name: Living Arsenal

R6VShH0DLHFMCM9B.Description:
A tactical survivor built around changing strategy as the scene changes.
Adaptive: At the start of each scene, choose Cunning, Stealth, or Survival. Cunning lets you mark Stress instead of spending Hope when you Utilize an Experience, doubling the Experience modifier. Stealth turns Hidden into Shrouded. Survival lets you mark 2 Stress when taking damage to mark 1 fewer Hit Point.
Resourceful: You start with a third Experience and gain one additional Stress slot.
Hope Feature - Endure: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Stress.
Class Items: A survival blade with alien-hide wrapping or a map of shifting terrain.
R6VShH0DLHFMCM9B.Name: Protean

ss6sIIHBB2qmlMU3.Description:
Deep Reserves: Gain +1 Stress.
Hardwired: You can have one cybernetic implant without gaining permanent Trauma. You start with Endocrine Synthesizer PEITHO and gain Subtle Pheromones: advantage on rolls to charm or persuade non-hostile creatures.
ss6sIIHBB2qmlMU3.Name: Transhuman - Infused

WgfZIlZVKBLJLQJx.Description: Nomadic: You do not need much to rest and settle in quickly. During a long rest, choose one additional downtime move.
WgfZIlZVKBLJLQJx.Name: Exodusrooted

YCeGdihRxEva6DvY.Description:
A Cheat subclass focused on marking, pursuing, and disabling a target.
Foundation - Dead or Alive: Spend a Hope to mark a target within Far range as your Bounty until they are defeated or the scene ends. You know their direction, add your level to damage against them, and can mark Stress after damaging them to make them temporarily Distracted or Vulnerable.
Specialization - No Escape: If your Bounty within Close range attempts to leave that range, you can move with them. Add Restrained and Dazed to the condition choices.
Mastery - Final Contract: When you damage your Bounty, give two conditions instead of one. Add Stunned to the condition choices.
YCeGdihRxEva6DvY.Name: Bounty Hunter

zgIVfv240GdrLvZ1.Description: Visions: You have advantage on rolls assessing situations ahead, planning, or understanding others, even without shared communication.
zgIVfv240GdrLvZ1.Name: Nebularooted

0eQoFikSk8o2D34e.Description: Discharged: fly up to Close range, then vault. Charged: spend a Charge to fly up to Far range. Overcharged: spend 2 Charges to fly until the scene ends, then vault.
0eQoFikSk8o2D34e.Name: Jet Pack

4SlVS00AxxgIUvSQ.Description: Make a Power Roll to attack a target within Very Close range for d8+2 kinetic damage using Proficiency. If the target is Vulnerable, use d12. Charged: spend a Charge to attack all targets within Very Close range with the same damage.
4SlVS00AxxgIUvSQ.Name: Monofilament Wire

5DCNFaV8FwI25PhL.Description: Gain advantage on rolls to distract a target within Close range or create a diversion. Charged: spend a Charge to make a Power Roll against all targets within Very Close range; successes are temporarily Distracted.
5DCNFaV8FwI25PhL.Name: Infrasonic Disruptor

AWpoHQdHG2VcyZON.Description: Discharged: clear a Stress, then vault. Charged: spend a Charge to clear a Stress on you or an ally within Melee. Overcharged: spend 2 Charges to clear 2 Hit Points and 2 Stress on you or an ally within Melee, then vault.
AWpoHQdHG2VcyZON.Name: Nanite Infusion

BdFv7IDdBcLT4uiw.Description: Make a Power Roll against all targets within Very Close range. On a success, they mark a Stress and are temporarily Restrained. Release: after use, flip it to Seal.
BdFv7IDdBcLT4uiw.Name: Torment of Cocytus - Release

c37skolPuZ0DSL4Y.Description: Place a snare at a visible point within Very Close range and roll Power trait d20s; moving targets make a Reaction Roll against the highest result or stop. Discharged vaults after placement. Charged adds temporary Restrained on failure. Overcharged makes failure Restrained and Stunned, success Restrained, then vaults.
c37skolPuZ0DSL4Y.Name: Pulse Snare

CD8b6gcWBM1CY4ad.Description: Your Evasion gains +1 against attacks from Melee range. Charged: spend a Charge to project a holographic copy within Far range; it has your Evasion, moves at your command, and vanishes when damaged, reused, or the scene ends.
CD8b6gcWBM1CY4ad.Name: Holo Decoy

Ceq9SiKlVCBgPqLh.Description: Make a primary weapon attack against a target within Melee range of one of your allies. On a success, deal damage and the ally can move up to Close range. On a success with Hope, add d6 to damage. Mark a Stress to make an ally Ordered until they roll with Fear.
Ceq9SiKlVCBgPqLh.Name: Cut and Shift

CoazCfxk15GT92Ba.Description: Make a Power Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal d12+3 energy damage using Proficiency and temporarily Ignite the target plus all targets within Very Close range. Release: after use, flip it to Seal.
CoazCfxk15GT92Ba.Name: Flames of Phlegethon - Release

FAlEIEEBMzaCKGRy.Description: Make a Power Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, once per rest they mark 1d4 Stress; clear Stress equal to the Stress they marked. Seal: after successfully using this card, mark a Hit Point to flip it to Release.
FAlEIEEBMzaCKGRy.Name: Stygian Tribute - Seal

FEO39GUtkY4AxboK.Description: When an ally within Far range takes damage, spend a Hope to let that ally move up to Close range.
FEO39GUtkY4AxboK.Name: Fall Back

FMVsjOF11OqVaxWj.Description: When an ally within Close range attacks a target with advantage, you gain advantage on your next attack against that target.
FMVsjOF11OqVaxWj.Name: An Advantage

fPmDYGzytAwAVWWW.Description: Discharged: after a successful weapon attack within Close range, add 1d8 damage, then vault this card. Charged: spend a Charge to arc 1d10 energy damage to another target within Very Close range of the first, Reaction Roll against your attack result for half. Overcharged: spend 2 Charges to arc 1d12 to all targets within Very Close range, then vault.
fPmDYGzytAwAVWWW.Name: Arc Unit

FTw9W3IKhMJv0rgH.Description: Make a Power Roll against a creature or device within Very Close range. On a success, a short memory or piece of data is temporarily erased. The GM can spend a Fear to resurface it. Seal: after successfully using this card, mark a Hit Point to flip it to Release.
FTw9W3IKhMJv0rgH.Name: Waters of Lethe - Seal

futIjMntAgp7oZ4s.Description: Gain advantage on an action roll to breach a secure network, open an electronic lock, or disable a device. Charged: on a success with Fear for that roll, spend a Charge to ignore negative consequences while the GM still gains Fear.
futIjMntAgp7oZ4s.Name: Holo AI-Demon

GZZ67oiW1uVYWvDp.Description: Alter your features and pigmentation, gaining advantage to hide your identity. Charged: spend a Charge to imitate a specific creature you have seen; place Power trait tokens on this card and spend one whenever you take an action until depleted.
GZZ67oiW1uVYWvDp.Name: Holographic Guise

L2eVqbdEViIWsdCu.Description: Gain advantage on rolls to hide. Charged: Make a Power Roll 10; on a success, spend a Charge and become Shrouded. Place Power trait tokens on this card and spend one when you take an action until depleted.
L2eVqbdEViIWsdCu.Name: Cloak Field

ngjblo5WtKxVnCqf.Description: Choose yourself or an ally within Very Close range. They instantly move to any visible space within Far range, then mark a Stress. Seal: after successfully using this card, mark a Hit Point to flip it to Release.
ngjblo5WtKxVnCqf.Name: Passage of Charon - Seal

OwCIDk5n7hiROfyz.Description: Project hard-light to gain advantage on rolls to climb. Charged: spend a Charge to pull yourself across gaps or up vertical surfaces to a location within Far range without a roll.
OwCIDk5n7hiROfyz.Name: Photonic Tether

P7BfzXzrhpgGzyGQ.Description: When you make a reaction roll, mark a Stress to add your Instinct or Knowledge. Once per rest when an ally in Very Close range would gain a condition, describe how your tactics help them avoid it.
P7BfzXzrhpgGzyGQ.Name: Adaptable Tactics

R4WT331SBtd9Lldd.Description: Discharged: Power Roll against a Close target; target and creatures within Melee make Reaction Roll 13 or take d20+5 energy damage using Proficiency, half on success, then vault. Charged: spend a Charge to affect Very Close range. Overcharged: spend 2 Charges to target Far range and affect Close range, then vault.
R4WT331SBtd9Lldd.Name: Nova Grenade

R9KDe9Ue5X7rzsBI.Description: Make a Power Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, spend a Hope to deal d6+1 energy damage using Proficiency. Seal: after successfully using this card, mark a Hit Point to flip it to Release.
R9KDe9Ue5X7rzsBI.Name: Flames of Phlegethon - Seal

RDEiCMMWgQGyNCXB.Description: Make a Power Roll against a creature or device within Very Close range. On a success, identity or data is temporarily erased. An adversary cannot use features; a device stops functioning. The GM can spend 2 Fear to resurface it. Release: after use, flip it to Seal.

0.Content:
Echo is an internal extraordinary power source, interpreted as psionics, biotics, paracausality, or another setting-appropriate force.
Echo is available to Broken, Resonant, Stray, and Primus. Broken and Resonant are volatile Echo users with lower maximums and stronger in-scene generation; Stray and Primus are reservoirs with deeper pools that usually recover through rest.
0.Name: Echo

0.Content:
Daggerheart SRD rules apply unless TNU says otherwise.
TNU domain cards use Skill, Tech, Psionic, Engram, and Sigil card types. In v2.0_Mind, the playable cards are Skill, Tech, and Sigil.
Charges are stored on Tech cards and charge-storing class features. After a long rest, unused Charge tokens are lost.
Sigil cards begin on their Seal side. After successful use, mark a Hit Point to flip to Release; after Release is used, flip back to Seal.
0.Name: New Rules in TNU

0.Content:
TNU uses Kinetic (kin) and Energy (ene) as damage types. In Foundryborn these are mapped to physical and magical damage where needed.
Scars are called Trauma. Each Trauma reduces maximum Hope by 1.
Dazzed: attack rolls take -2. Distracted: Difficulty takes -2. Hidden: rolls against you have disadvantage until you reveal yourself. Shrouded: Hidden, and you remain unseen while stationary. Restrained: you cannot move. Stunned: no reactions and no other action. Vulnerable: rolls targeting you have advantage. Weakened: disadvantage on attack rolls.
Spellcast Trait is called Power Trait in TNU.
0.Name: Terminology and Conditions

0.Content:
Playtest v2.0_Mind includes full rules for Protean, Cheat, and Architect, plus Spectre, Bounty Hunter, and Living Arsenal foundation subclasses.
Sphere of Mind: Mercury - The Impulse, Saturn - The Shadow, Uranus - The Spark.
Sphere of Heart: Pluto - The End, Venus - The Voice, Terra - The Seed.
Sphere of Fist: Neptune - The Dream, Jupiter - The Shield, Mars - The Sword.
0.Name: Classes and Domains Overview

0.Content:
NARI-5 has one year left under a failing worldshield as CARMINE approaches death-bloom.
Rifts open across the neon city-planet and release demonic swarms. Player characters are wired outcasts hired to cull outbreaks, steal shield resources, and chase rumors of the Ark.
Tone: neon, maximalist, ferocious, sleek, desperate-but-defiant, techno. Themes: last pleasure, contracted violence, survival by theft.
